evidence: ASSIGN TO DISK with ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED

purpose.domain_detail: ATM (cajero automatico) balance inquiry module for a fictional UnizarBank, reading from an indexed movements file
purpose.summary: This program is a balance inquiry subprogram for a simple ATM simulation called UnizarBank. It accepts a card number (TNUM) via LINKAGE SECTION, reads an indexed file of transactions to find the most recent movement for that card, and displays the current balance on a terminal screen. It handles the case of no movements and system errors with appropriate screen messages.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (FOREGROUND-COLOR, BACKGROUND-COLOR)
CRT STATUS for keyboard input handling
LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING
SET ENVIRONMENT for GnuCOBOL screen exceptions
Indexed file with DYNAMIC access mode
Spanish-language display text (Cajero Automatico, Consulta de saldo)
GO TO used extensively for flow control
verdict.notes: Program is clearly a student project (UnizarBank likely references Universidad de Zaragoza). Spanish language UI text. Uses GO TO heavily for control flow. No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS. The file path './../movimientos.ubd' is relative, consistent with a local development/student environment.
